variety_description: Extremely high yielding, late maturity, medium tall, long slender grain variety suitable for cultivation across country under irrigated lowland growing conditions. Released in 2019 and recommended for planting in Boro season due to low water requirement and higher yield than commonly grown variety BRRI dhan29. Good plant type with sturdy stem and straight flag leaf. Tolerant to lodging and shattering.
